purpose: Make delegated Codex Chat and Claude authority policy changes mechanically truth-sensitive so capability-source edits cannot report a false zero-file Documentation Truth green or bypass the founder-final execution boundary.

claims: `src/authority/delegatedAgentAuthority.ts` must remain a policy-only eligibility layer that never authorizes provider mutation or verified completion and requires a separately trusted activation path before merge or deploy execution.

`security/delegated-agent-authority.json` must preserve standing capability separately from standing execution approval and must keep database, secret, auth/RLS, billing, publication, provider-ownership, and destructive authority outside the delegated policy.

`scripts/verify-documentation-truth.mjs` must classify non-test `src/authority/` policy source and `security/delegated-agent-authority.json` as capability-authority so future delegated-authority changes cannot pass with zero truth-sensitive files.
